experiences.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace & Hanbok Experience
experiences.description: Explore the iconic Joseon-era palace and rent a traditional Hanbok for free entry and stunning photos. Arrive early to catch the ceremonial guard changing at the main gate. This is a must for K-culture and history lovers, and the surrounding Bukchon Hanok Village is walkable for an extended cultural morning.

experiences.name: Gwangjang Market Street Food Tour
experiences.description: Dive into one of Seoul's oldest and most beloved traditional markets. Sample iconic local dishes including bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes), mayak gimbap, tteokbokki, and fresh yukhoe (beef tartare) straight from market vendors. This is an authentic, immersive local food experience beloved by both locals and food enthusiasts, and is centrally located for easy access from most accommodation hubs.

experiences.name: K-Pop & Hallyu Culture Tour in Hongdae
experiences.description: Spend an evening in the vibrant Hongdae district, the heartbeat of K-pop and youth culture. Enjoy live street performances, visit K-pop merchandise stores, explore indie music venues, and try a K-pop dance class at one of the many studios in the area. This neighborhood is lively from late afternoon into the night and is ideal for K-culture enthusiasts. Staying nearby maximizes time and minimizes transit.

experiences.name: Insadong Cultural Street & Tea House Experience
experiences.description: Stroll through Insadong's charming alleyways filled with traditional tea houses, Korean craft shops, galleries, and street food stalls. Stop into a traditional Korean tea house for a ceremonial tea tasting experience. This area is a cultural gem that blends old and new Seoul, and is conveniently close to Gyeongbokgung and Gwangjang Market, making it easy to combine into a single day itinerary.

experiences.name: Myeongdong Night Food Crawl & K-Beauty Shopping
experiences.description: Explore Myeongdong's famous pedestrian street after dark when food stalls come alive with Korean street food including hotteok, corn dogs, lobster skewers, and egg bread. Combine with browsing K-beauty flagship stores like Innisfree, Etude House, and Olive Young. This is a quintessential Seoul evening experience that blends local food culture with the K-beauty phenomenon, and is centrally located with excellent metro access.
